_readme: Autonomous idle mode for kjlape.overlay-screensaver. Copy to ~/.config/overlay-screensaver/config.json. Precedence: shell.json plugins[] entry > this file > built-in defaults. PREREQUISITE for auto-show: turn the stock Omarchy screensaver OFF first (omarchy toggle screensaver) — two screensavers break the auto-lock. Then run: omarchy-overlay-screensaver enable
